title: Which food has more energy? Choose the basis first

beats.text: Which food has more energy? That question isn't complete until you say: more energy per what? Here are two foods with illustrative label values. Nuts: two thousand five hundred kilojoules per one hundred grams. Cooked pasta: six hundred and fifty kilojoules per one hundred grams.
Per one hundred grams, the nuts win easily, because they're rich in fat and contain little water.

But a typical serving of nuts might be twenty-five grams, which is six hundred and twenty-five kilojoules. A serving of pasta might be two hundred and fifty grams, which is one thousand six hundred and twenty-five kilojoules. Per serving, the pasta wins.
Both statements are true. They answer different questions. In an exam, state the basis, show the numbers for both foods on that basis, and only then make the comparison.
